select t.*,(st_distance(point(t.tearoom_longitude, t.tearoom_latitude), point(#{longitude}, #{latitude})) * 111195) as distance, u.user_name as userName,u.phone from tearoom t left join tb_user u on u.user_id=t.user_id where 1=1
and t.tearoom_city like concat('%',#{city},'%')
and t.status = #{status}
and t.tearoom_name like concat('%',#{tearoomName},'%')
and t.tearoom_phone like concat('%',#{tearoomPhone},'%')
and t.user_id = #{userId}
and t.tearoom_type = #{tearoomType}
and (t.user_id = #{tearoomUserId} or t.employee_user_ids like concat('%,',#{tearoomUserId},'') or t.employee_user_ids like concat('',#{tearoomUserId},',%') or t.employee_user_ids like concat('%,',#{tearoomUserId},',%') or t.employee_user_ids = #{tearoomUserId} )
and t.shop_type = #{shopType}
and t.is_vip_privilege = #{isVipPrivilege}
order by
distance asc
t.create_time desc
t.sales asc
t.sales desc
distance asc
distance desc

select t.*,(st_distance(point(t.tearoom_longitude, t.tearoom_latitude), point(#{longitude}, #{latitude})) * 111195) as distance, u.user_name as userName,u.phone, (select count(*) from goods g where g.goods_category=1 and g.tearoom_id=t.tearoom_id) as kuaiCount, (select count(*) from goods g where g.goods_category=1 and g.tearoom_id=t.tearoom_id and g.goods_status=2) as kuaiCount2, (select count(*) from goods g where g.goods_category=2 and g.tearoom_id=t.tearoom_id) as manCount, (select count(*) from goods g where g.goods_category=2 and g.tearoom_id=t.tearoom_id and g.goods_status=2) as manCount2 from tearoom t left join tb_user u on u.user_id=t.user_id where t.tearoom_id=#{tearoomId}
